diagnostics.message: splunk_configs_conf.forgecicd_cloudwatchlogs references the transform "forgecicd_trust_validation" via variables["REPORT-forgecicd_trust_validation"], but has no dependency on splunk_configs_conf.forgecicd_trust_validation. Since the transform name is a plain string (no attribute reference exists), the props stanza could be created before the transform, producing a props entry whose REPORT points at a nonexistent transform. All other REPORT-referenced transforms in this resource are covered by depends_on, making this omission look like an oversight.

splunk_configs_conf.forgecicd_cloudwatchlogs references the transform "forgecicd_extra_lambda_ec2_tenant_fields" via variables["REPORT-forgecicd_extra_lambda_ec2_tenant_fields"], but has no dependency on splunk_configs_conf.forgecicd_extra_lambda_ec2_tenant_fields. The transform name is only a string literal, so Terraform will not infer the ordering; without an explicit depends_on the props stanza may be applied before the transform exists, unlike its sibling REPORT-* entries (lambda_tenant_fields, global_lambda_tenant_fields, extra_lambda_tenant_fields) which are covered.
